description: a broad-shouldered slavic man warrior for hire in his forties, a shaved head and a thick fair beard braided in two, calm hazel eyes, a studded leather jerkin over a mail shirt, a wide belt, dark trousers and leather boots, a big axe held low in his right hand at his side, its head down by his knee, his left arm swinging free, exactly two arms and two hands, nothing on his shoulder, seen from the side, facing and walking to the right, upright mid-step in the pose of the grey mannequin, the same size and place as the mannequin, the whole figure from the top of the head to the feet inside the image, isolated figure on a plain background, forest fantasy

references.usage: the character's look: face, beard, clothes and colours; not how the arms hold the axe
the pose, size and place of the figure: seen from the side, facing right, upright mid-step; copy it exactly
how to hold the axe: low in the front hand at the side while walking, its head down by the knee, the other arm free; only the axe's hold, not this figure's look
